digest.component_or_area: rebar-janitor codebase-health audit and remediation pipeline
propositions: A comprehensive codebase-health janitor audit executed four sequential phases (Discovery, Verification, Remediation, Approval) against fixed snapshot 9a94ef9737fbdf070ae314bba6e797319aee2301, identified 113 raw findings, deduplicated to 78 candidates, verified 47 survivors, and produced 37 remediation items with phase-4 decisions spanning approvals, refinements, rejections, and deferrals.

37 Janitor remediation items (RP01–RP37) received explicit phase-4 decisions: 19 approved for cleanup epic ticketization, 7 rejected without known-fine entries, 4 deferred for future runs, and 7 requiring prerequisite work or maintainer reconsideration before ticket creation.

The approved Janitor Cleanup epic includes fsck-repair staging, config-surface bidirectionality, behavioral oracles, MCP-health handshake extraction, Jira link canonicalization, Docker test boundaries, deprecation/compatibility-shim removal, documentation/schema generation, and third-party action pinning, with 21 planned child tickets.

RP02 (reconcile.py residual representation cleanup) was absorbed and refined into existing epic financial-stoneware-brant with two new parented child tickets (piscine-bullish-cowbird and gnarled-wraithlike-flatfish) to preserve headroom and post-typed-payload producer-input convergence before Brant completion.

RP04 (close-workflow single-operation-snapshot authority versus mid-operation sync.push re-reads) deferred as idea unadult-emptiable-porpoise for architecture resolution; RP11 (reconciler package relocation) rejected pending re-audit at Brant's terminal SHA with fresh census and experiments; RP12 (wire-dialect resolver) deferred awaiting OpenAI Chat-to-Responses migration completion.

Phase-4 compatibility decision approved removal of all scheduled deprecations (transition(force_close=...), transition(force=True), hosted-OpenAI openai-chat), permanent env/config aliases, entire CLI reconcile family, and Python/MCP operation aliases, with prerequisite ADR prohibiting future internal-only shims and atomic reachability migration before deletion.
